columns.name: i_rad
columns.meaning: radial bin index, 0 innermost of 5 over 0.2-3.5 h^-1 Mpc

columns.name: j_az
columns.meaning: azimuthal sector index, 0-7, position angle east of north

columns.name: kT
columns.meaning: eRASS1 X-ray temperature, keV, blank where unmeasured

columns.name: R_mpc
columns.meaning: weighted mean physical radius of the lensing sources in the cell

columns.name: pa_deg
columns.meaning: weighted mean position angle of those sources

columns.name: g_t
columns.meaning: tangential reduced shear, metacalibration response applied

columns.name: g_x
columns.meaning: cross component -- must be consistent with zero; a null, not a feature

columns.name: n_phot
columns.meaning: Chandra photons in the cell, 0.5-7 keV, good grades

columns.name: sb
columns.meaning: photons per square arcmin. NOT exposure corrected

columns.name: hardness
columns.meaning: H/(S+H) temperature proxy, blank below 25 photons

columns.name: hardness_asym
columns.meaning: hardness minus this cluster's radial median -- vignetting-free

columns.name: sb_asym
columns.meaning: log10 sb minus this cluster's radial median -- the asymmetry

columns.name: xray_covered
columns.meaning: 1 if Chandra observed this cell's radius at all

nulls: g_x must be consistent with zero on any subset used
permute cluster labels to destroy the baryon-gravity association
permute j_az within a cluster to destroy the ASYMMETRY while leaving every radial quantity intact -- the null that matters here, because a purely radial model survives it
caveats: sb is not exposure corrected: vignetting and chip gaps are in it. Use sb_asym, which has the radial part removed, for anything that must not depend on the instrument.
hardness is a proxy, not a temperature, and is not comparable between clusters at different redshift or epoch.
outer cells often fall outside the Chandra field; xray_covered flags that and unflagged rows must be dropped, not imputed.
